subject.title: fix(zai): add user-agent header to endpoint detection probe

question: Which Z.AI User-Agent fix path should be treated as canonical before merge: this one-line branch after adding proof/tests, or a better-tested sibling PR?
rationale: The code change is plausible, but contributor proof is mock-only and several open branches attempt the same canonical issue, so automation should not choose the final landing path.

options.title: Choose a tested canonical branch
options.body: Select one narrow PR with regression coverage and live proof or an explicit proof waiver, then close duplicate candidates after it lands.

options.title: Continue this branch after proof
options.body: Ask this contributor to add focused header regression coverage and redacted after-fix Z.AI endpoint-detection proof before this branch remains a landing candidate.

options.title: Waive live proof for a minimal fix
options.body: Maintainers can accept the issue reporter's live before-fix evidence plus source inspection, but should still land only one duplicate fix.

recommendation.title: Choose a tested canonical branch
recommendation.body: Select one narrow PR with regression coverage and live proof or an explicit proof waiver, then close duplicate candidates after it lands.
